examples.text: Na próżno kapela wygrywała skoczne dryganty, sztajery i menuety, liberia, w białych kosmatych surdutach, niestrudzenie roznosiła słodkie muszkatele i alikanty, a czarujące gospodynie usiłowały ożywić gnuśną zabawę - nuda nie dała się rozproszyć.

glosses: Having long, thick, and uncombed hair, fur or wool.

examples.text: They waited until Dorothy awoke the next morning. The little girl was quite frightened when she saw the great pile of shaggy wolves, but the Tin Woodman told her all. She thanked him for saving them and sat down to breakfast, after which they started again upon their journey.

Away from the village, there was an enclosure containing several large animals of a kind I had not seen before—shaggy, long-necked, small-headed creatures who stood or lay at ease around their pen. Alpacas?

glosses: Having a surface like shaggy hair; with a rough nap.

examples.text: Universal and Blumhouse’s M3gan is exactly the right amount of ridiculous, which is why it can afford to be a little shaggy toward the end.
